purpose: Define the three prediction-evidence cohorts of the locked 30-candidate panel before any cohort is selected. The cohorts differ along exactly one axis, the identity and remoteness of a single aldehyde component, so that the panel reads as one interpretable progression rather than four unrelated generalization problems.

naming.note: Prediction-evidence cohorts are Q/N/X. Route-evidence labels remain R1/R2/R3. The earlier Tier A/B/C naming is retired because it collided with route evidence.
naming.Q: Qualified: all component identities measured, only the combination is new
naming.N: Near-boundary analog transfer: exactly one unseen aldehyde inside the similarity envelope
naming.X: Extrapolative: exactly one unseen aldehyde beyond the similarity envelope

single_axis_contract.varied: identity and remoteness of the aldehyde component only
single_axis_contract.held_constant: amine head and isocyanide identities must be measured in every cohort; exact Ugi forward verification and route completeness are required in every cohort
single_axis_contract.excluded_from_all_cohorts: unseen amine heads, unseen isocyanides, and any design with more than one unseen component. A multiple-new-component or new-head design may be synthesized as an explicitly labelled moonshot but is never aggregated into Q, N or X.

similarity_envelope.metric: Tanimoto on Morgan fingerprints, radius 2, 2048 bits
similarity_envelope.derivation: minimum internal nearest-neighbour similarity among the 11 measured aldehydes; a generated aldehyde at or above it is at least as close to the measured set as the most isolated measured aldehyde, for which the oracle already issues qualified predictions

Q_high.selection: highest lcb90 subject to the diversity rule
Q_high.preference: drawn from the qualified role-holdout authority tier where available

Q_low.membership: same qualified and route-complete population as Q_high
Q_low.selection: lowest lcb90 among candidates that survive the matching contract

matching_contract.requirement: controls must differ from Q_high in prespecified oracle rank and in nothing else that could independently explain an activity difference
balanced_on: synthetic-route confidence, meaning the same route standard and comparable step count
molecular weight and cLogP within the Q_high range
matching_contract.prohibited: selecting malformed, insoluble, synthetically dubious or chemically repetitive low-ranked candidates

N_transfer.membership: exactly one unseen aldehyde, similarity to measured >= 0.65, amine and isocyanide identities measured, exact forward verified, route complete
N_transfer.ordering_score: conservative ensemble score, ensemble_mean minus ensemble_standard_deviation
N_transfer.ordering_rationale: AGILE ranked their ~12,000-member candidate library by this statistic and recovered H9. It penalises high-variance extrapolation, which the raw mean does not. It is not the calibrated lower bound, which is undefined outside the qualified region.

composition.lower_edge_definition: highest conservative score among eligible candidates whose aldehyde similarity falls in the lowest quartile of the eligible N pool, so the cohort probes the envelope boundary as well as exploiting it

X_extrapolative.membership: exactly one unseen aldehyde, similarity to measured < 0.65, amine and isocyanide identities measured, exact forward verified, route complete
X_extrapolative.ordering_score: conservative ensemble score, ensemble_mean minus ensemble_standard_deviation

composition.rationale: Selecting all four at one extreme would answer only one question. Two drawn from just below the envelope and two from the most remote eligible aldehydes give a gradient, which is what makes a four-member exploratory cohort interpretable.
composition.note: This split is an implementation judgement recorded here rather than inherited from the authority, which specifies only that X lies beyond the envelope.

route.definition: every component either purchasable or reduced to purchasable material by a forward-verified route

physicochemical_screen.note: 1st to 99th percentile envelope of the qualified population; every cohort must fall inside the same envelope

diversity.metric: Tanimoto on Morgan fingerprints, radius 2, 2048 bits, between complete products

analysis_contract.secondary_endpoint: thresholded hit rate, reported as interpretable but not as the primary analysis
analysis_contract.power_statement: Expanding 6-versus-2 to 12-versus-6 makes the enrichment analysis substantially more informative and gives it a realistic chance of formal significance if the effect is large. Ex ante power at true rates 67% versus 10%, one-sided alpha 0.05, is 0.65. Do not describe it as guaranteed or as properly powered.
analysis_contract.population_separation: N and X are never pooled into the Q primary analysis, and never pooled with each other
analysis_contract.intention_to_test: 30 locked, route attempted, correct product isolated, formulation QC passed, biological assay completed. Failures remain in the denominator. Backups may be prepared operationally but any replacement is separately labelled.
analysis_contract.generation_arm_comparison: broad versus support-enriched remains computational and consumes no wet-lab slot

required: formulation-system control where the assay requires it
benchmarks.h9: external precedent only; a direct H9 arm is not mandatory and the paper does not need to prove our model ranks H9

nonclaims: Cohort membership is not a prediction of activity.
N eligibility does not assert validated generalization to unseen aldehydes.
Four X candidates support a case study, not a statistical claim about extrapolation.
The conservative ensemble score carries no coverage guarantee outside the qualified region.

screen_correction_2026-08-06.what: Added allene, enol, hemiacetal/gem-diol, anhydride, ketene, carbamic acid and imine/oxime to the excluded-motif list.
screen_correction_2026-08-06.why: The first X selection surfaced candidates containing OC(O)=C enols, C=C=C allenes and OC(O) hemiacetals. These are tautomer and valence artifacts of generation rather than stable synthetic targets, and the Tail A route correctly failed to resolve them. The frozen configuration already required exclusion of pathological motifs; the SMARTS implementation under-covered that requirement.
screen_correction_2026-08-06.scope: Applies to all cohorts. Q and N selections are unaffected in practice because those candidates resolve through verified routes, which such motifs cannot.
